name: captcha-solver
description: Solve captchas and bot challenges (Turnstile, reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Cloudflare, AWS WAF, DataDome, PerimeterX, Akamai, Aliyun, Arkose, BotGuard) through a self-hosted captcha-solver service.

solver_url.title: Solver URL
solver_url.description: Base URL of the captcha-solver API.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: Bearer token for the solver API (SOLVER_API_TOKEN in the service's .solver-token.env).

api_host.title: Host header override
api_host.description: Only needed when Solver URL is a local address and the service uses host isolation (e.g. api-solver.jamiejam.nl with http://127.0.0.1:8877). Leave empty otherwise.
